label: Sulley
description: Big, warm and gentle: the top scarer who would much rather reassure you.
direction: Speak deep, warm and gentle, a big friendly rumble: easygoing, protective and reassuring, with a soft chuckle behind the words. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. James P. Sullivan as the gentle giant. The comfort is the character; nothing here should sound like a roar. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nice and easy.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Doing great, buddy.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Easy does it, buddy.
lines.start_drive_1: Hey, buddy. Ready to roll? Let's go.
lines.start_drive_2: Kitty's driving! Well, navigating. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_3: We scare because we care. Today, we drive because we care.
lines.start_drive_4: Morning, Mikey! Oh. You're not Mike. Well, let's go anyway.
lines.start_drive_5: Top scarer, top navigator. Stick with me, buddy.
lines.start_drive_6: Big guy on board. Don't worry, I'll watch the road for you.
lines.start_drive_7: Okay, deep breath. Seat belt on. Here we go.
lines.start_drive_8: Mike says I'm out of shape. So today, we drive. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_9: Don't be scared. It's just a drive. I've got you.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That's okay, buddy. Happens to the best of us.
lines.arrived: We're here. Nice driving, buddy. Kitty has to go now.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Nice and easy.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. You've got this.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, big roundabout.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. No use roaring at it. Believe me, I tried.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down, buddy. Careful now.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Stay close. I've got you.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Nice and slow, buddy.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Whoa, stop there.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Nothing to be scared of. Just slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops. Missed it. No big deal, I know another door.
